COLDWAR_FRA_apply_public_scrutiny = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_FRA_institutions_government = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_public_scrutiny_earned }
		}
		add_political_power = -35
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_public_scrutiny_earned
		COLDWAR_FRA_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_FRA_apply_research_gaullist_a = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_FRA_gaullist_government = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_research_gaullist_a_earned }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_armament_gaullist_a_followup_earned
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_armament_gaullist_b_followup_earned
			}
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_research_gaullist_b_earned }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_dlc = "No Step Back"
					is_special_project_completed = sp:sp_armoured_vehicle_project
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_tech = mbt_tech_1 }
					}
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_dlc = "No Step Back" }
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_tech = MBT_2 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_political_power = -75
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dlc = "No Step Back"
			}
			add_tech_bonus = {
				name = COLDWAR_FRA_research_gaullist_a_award
				bonus = 0.5
				uses = 1
				technology = mbt_tech_1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_dlc = "No Step Back" }
			}
			add_tech_bonus = {
				name = COLDWAR_FRA_research_gaullist_a_award
				bonus = 0.5
				uses = 1
				technology = MBT_2
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_research_gaullist_a_earned
		COLDWAR_FRA_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}

				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_armament_national_b_followup_earned
			}
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_b_earned }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_dlc = "No Step Back"
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_tech = nsb_arty_upgrade_1 }
						NOT = { has_tech = nsb_artillery_2 }
					}
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_dlc = "No Step Back" }
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_tech = arty_upgrade_1 }
						NOT = { has_tech = tech_arty_1 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_political_power = -75
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dlc = "No Step Back"
			}
			add_tech_bonus = {
				name = COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_a_award
				bonus = 0.5
				uses = 1
				technology = nsb_arty_upgrade_1
				technology = nsb_artillery_2
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_dlc = "No Step Back" }
			}
			add_tech_bonus = {
				name = COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_a_award
				bonus = 0.5
				uses = 1
				technology = arty_upgrade_1
				technology = tech_arty_1
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_a_earned
		COLDWAR_FRA_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_FRA_apply_research_national_b = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_FRA_national_government = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_b_earned }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_armament_national_a_followup_earned
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_armament_national_b_followup_earned
			}
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_a_earned }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_dlc = "No Step Back"
					is_special_project_completed = sp:sp_armoured_vehicle_project
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_tech = mbt_tech_1 }
					}
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_dlc = "No Step Back" }
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_tech = MBT_2 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_political_power = -75
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dlc = "No Step Back"
			}
			add_tech_bonus = {
				name = COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_b_award
				bonus = 0.5
				uses = 1
				technology = mbt_tech_1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_dlc = "No Step Back" }
			}
			add_tech_bonus = {
				name = COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_b_award
				bonus = 0.5
				uses = 1
				technology = MBT_2
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_b_earned
		COLDWAR_FRA_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}

				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_production_speed_offices_factor = 0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_social_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.04 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_executive_enforcement_network_earned }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_political_power_factor = 0.075 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_police_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_stability_factor = -0.025 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_national_service_reserve_earned }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_army_core_defence_factor = 0.07 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_army_morale_factor = 0.025 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_training_time_factor = 0.05 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_professional_expedition_cadre_earned }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_army_org_factor = 0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_training_time_factor = -0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_army_core_defence_factor = -0.03 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_army_personnel_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.12 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_armament_national_a_earned }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_industrial_capacity_factory = 0.075 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_production_factory_max_efficiency_factor = 0.025 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_equipment_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.075 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_armament_national_a_followup_earned }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_production_speed_arms_factory_factor = 0.1 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor = -0.025 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_armament_national_b_earned }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_equipment_cost_multiplier_modifier = -0.075 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_production_factory_max_efficiency_factor = 0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_industrial_capacity_factory = -0.025 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_armament_national_b_followup_earned }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_supply_consumption_factor = -0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_national_production_speed_arms_factory_factor = -0.025 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_small_traders_earned
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_tax_revolt_earned
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_national_preference_earned
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_municipal_base_earned
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_electoral_normalisation_earned
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_confrontational_state_earned
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_municipal_service_compact_earned
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_executive_enforcement_network_earned
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_national_service_reserve_earned
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_professional_expedition_cadre_earned
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_armament_national_a_earned
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_armament_national_a_followup_earned
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_armament_national_b_earned
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_armament_national_b_followup_earned
					}
				}
				if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_FRA_national_programme } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_FRA_national_programme } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_FRA_national_programme } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_FRA_national_programme } }
		}
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_full_tree_visible_v1 } }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_full_tree_visible_v1
			mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_last_party = ruling_party } }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_last_party = ruling_party }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_government_epoch = 1 }
			mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_FN_identity } date > 1972.10.4 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_FN_identity
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_government_epoch = 1 }
			mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_FRA_offer_maintenance = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_FRA_1970_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_FRA_is_1970 = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_1970_initialized } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_1970_initialized
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_FRA_presidential_republic
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_FRA_unsettled_social_compromise
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_FRA_uneven_modernisation
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_last_party = -1 }
	}
	COLDWAR_FRA_refresh_programmes = yes
}
